doc.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016

title: Best and worst gigs, including the last Nexus concert
summary: A great show after a tired tour, a Montreal crowd, and a botched theme song at the final Nexus concert.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Yeah. It was delightful. This is always a hard question. Can you recall a best gig ever and a worst gig ever?

Well there are some gigs that you certainly remember. I don’t really — I mean we had an amazing experience in Montreal when we were supposed to play outside and there was some highway or something we were supposed to play. And where we ended up it was crowded with people. I had never played with such — that was a big experience. But I think I can mention another one. We had a gig, in fact in my home town, we had been on tour, and the last day we had a long, long, long travel, I mean ten hours in the bus or something like that. And it was at the end of a tour and we were tired and we were a little bit sick and we had this long travel, and we just ended up saying we can’t possibly play, this must be the most terrible situation. So we just sat down and think nothing will happen. But it was an amazing concert. One of the best we did. About the worst, I will tell a little story. Of course there are not many situations where you are not happy with what’s happening — coming in and finding an empty place or something. All musicians have had that experience. But I can tell you about the last concert with Nexus, when we decided to finish the group, after a little more than 20 years. At that point of course everyone wanted to do their best, to have a good memory of an ending. And in a way I think it was a very concentrated concert with very few mistakes and many things happening. And then we had an encore, and then we played — I don’t know the English word the theme of the group, or what do you call it, a song you always play that is connected to you. So this was a song we always played, and played forever. And we made a mistake on that song. Because everything was a big success, and so we could play it in our sleep, and we kind of f***ed it up a little bit. And that was very embarrassing. I still remember that feeling. Some mistakes of communication.
Right I see. So that was your last number.
Yeah. In a way it was.
